hebrewText: לֵךְ֩ וְ/דִבַּרְתָּ֨ אֶל דָּוִ֜יד לֵ/אמֹ֗ר כֹּ֚ה אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֔ה שָׁל֕וֹשׁ אֲנִ֖י נֹטֶ֣ה עָלֶ֑י/ךָ בְּחַר לְ/ךָ֛ אַחַ֥ת מֵ/הֵ֖נָּה וְ/אֶֽעֱשֶׂה לָּֽ/ךְ

tokens.bdb: to walk (literally or figuratively); causatively, to carry (in various senses)

tokens.bdb: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
